thread: Anya: heads-up — i'm starting the big rename of /docs/reference -> /docs/api-reference today. planning to split into multiple small PRs so we don't break the site. brief plan below, need reviewers and merge windows. Matt: 👍 what's the first PR? rename only or move + edit anchors? Anya: first PR will be a pure move (keeps file contents identical). second PR will update anchors and cross-links. third PR adds new examples and snippets. keeping them separate so redirects can be added incrementally. Sofia: can we get CI/docs preview for each PR? the preview build needs to include redirects so links don't explode for internal testing. Anya: yes — each PR will include a redirects.yaml in the same change that maps old paths to new ones. example: # redirects.yaml (example) - from: /docs/reference/auth to: /docs/api-reference/auth Anya: note — the redirect format is the one our docs site expects. i'll paste real mapping in the first PR. Jorge: anchor collisions are my worry. If we move files the heading IDs might change (esp. with slugs). we should run anchor-checker before merging. i can add a job to CI that fails on broken anchors. Anya: yep, i'll add a job to the docs CI that runs `yarn docs:link-check && node scripts/anchor-check.js`. if it fails we won't merge. Sam: who are the reviewers? i can take the first-two PRs but will be OOO tmrw afternoon. @matt? @sofia? Matt: i can review the pure-move PRs during my morning. prefer merges before 2pm PT to avoid cross-team deploys. Sofia: i'll review redirects and cross-link updates. will also validate Private deployment docs (those live in the same folder and are sensitive). Docs Bot: preview build posted: https://deploy.previews.redwood.test/1768504321 — anchor-check failed on "auth#token-exchange" in /docs/api-reference/auth.md :exclamation: Anya: ok seen. looks like the heading ID changed from "token-exchange" to "token-exchange-v2" after a small wording tweak. i'll update the redirect anchors mapping and re-push. Jorge: small tip — instead of relying on heading text, add explicit anchors in markdown like "" before the heading. that keeps anchors stable across wording changes. Anya: good call. i'll add explicit anchors where we need stable links (especially migration guides referenced externally). Sam: sequence wise, propose this order: 1) PR A: move files only + redirects.yaml (pure move) 2) Merge and wait for preview propagation (~5-10 min) 3) PR B: update anchors + internal links 4) PR C: examples + SDK snippets + minor copy edits Sam: we should avoid merging PR B until redirects from A are in prod, otherwise external links might 404. Matt: agree. also tag PRs with `docs/refactor/phase-1` and `needs-review` so reviewers can filter. Sofia: for CI — can we add a non-blocking job that builds the live redirects manifest and posts a short report as a comment? Docs Bot could do that. Docs Bot: will add comment on each PR with redirect manifest snippet and link-check summary. Anya: about timing — i'll aim to open PR A by 11:00 PT, will request reviews from @matt and @sam. if we get green CI + anchor-check, merge window 11:30–12:30 PT. Matt: i'll prioritize review then. Jorge: i'll queue a patch to anchor-checker so it reports both broken outbound anchors and changed slugs with suggested fixups. Anya: one more edge case — some external blog posts link to anchors deep in the docs. we should keep a mapping file `legacy-anchors.json` and commit it to the repo so the redirect service can map old anchor fragments. Sofia: can the redirect layer handle fragment-only redirects? e.g., /docs/reference/auth#token-exchange -> /docs/api-reference/auth#token-exchange-v2 Matt: current infra supports path redirects but not fragment rewriting. adding fragment mapping will require a small runtime change (2–3 days). in the meantime we should preserve old anchor IDs in the target docs where feasible. Anya: agreed: plan A — add explicit anchors matching legacy IDs. Plan B — kickoff runtime fragment mapping if we find many mismatches. Sam: i can do a quick grep across our support tickets for broken anchors; if it's only a handful we'll add explicit anchors. Docs Bot: link-check summary posted in PR A comment: 8 internal redirects, 0 broken file links, 1 anchor mismatch — see details. Anya: thanks. once PR A is merged i'll monitor the site for 30 minutes and coordinate merging PR B. i'll post here when i'm about to merge. Matt: :thumbsup: Sofia: :rocket: CI Bot: merge queue note — PR A requires 2 approvals. queue position 3. will re-run CI on push. Anya: opening PR A now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 Anya: (editing mapping and adding explicit anchors in follow-up commits) Jorge: great. ping here when the preview shows green and redirect manifest published. Anya: will do — thanks everyone!
